result.topic_en: Draft passage from Riemann's dissertation showing that the line integral of u dx/ds − v dy/ds is path-independent, which defines a function U with dU/dx = u and dU/dy = −v that satisfies the conditions of Art. 10; it then begins § 20 on the general rule for determining a function from boundary conditions.

methods.what: Construction of a potential function U whose partial derivatives are u and −v
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial U}{\partial x}=u$ und $\frac{\partial U}{\partial y}=-v$ ist.

methods.what: Complex function formed from the partial derivatives of U

items.quote: die Function U ist daher nebst allen ihren Differentialquotienten in allen Punkten von T endlich und stetig und dasselbe gilt folglich auch von der complexen Function $w=\frac{\partial U}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial U}{\partial y}i$ und ihren nach z genommenen Diff. quot.
items.english: the function U, together with all its derivatives, is therefore finite and continuous at all points of T, and consequently the same holds for the complex function w = ∂U/∂x − i ∂U/∂y and its derivatives taken with respect to z.
